The company claims to be "the first publishing company ever devoted exclusively to science fiction and fantasy."

July 11, 2022 - In 1982 Betsy married “freak folk” musician Peter Stampfel and they have two daughters, Zoe and Lily. In 2022, DAW was purchased by Thinkingdom Media Group (Beijing) to be the SFF line of Astra Publishing House.
